[[Providence Park|Civic Stadium]] }} {{1984 Pacific-10 Conference football standings}} The '''1984 Oregon State Beavers football team''' represented [[Oregon State University]] as a member of the [[Pac-12 Conference|Pacific-10 Conference]] (Pac-10) during the [[1984 NCAA Division I-A football season]]. Led by [[Joe Avezzano]] in his fifth and final season as head coach, the Beavers compiled an overall record of 2–9 with a mark of 1–7 in conference play, placing ninth in the Pac-10.{{cite news |url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=QN1VAAAAIBAJ&sjid=WeEDAAAAIBAJ&pg=3866%2C5195882|work=Eugene Register-Guard |location=Oregon |last=Cawood |first=Neil |title=Where does this leave Avezzano? |date=November 18, 1984 |page=1E}} Oregon State played five home games on campus at [[Reser Stadium|Parker Stadium]] in [[Corvallis, Oregon|Corvallis]], and one at [[Providence Park|Civic Stadium]] in [[Portland, Oregon|Portland]]. Avezzano was fired after the season. In his five years as head coach, he posted a record of {{winpct|6|47|2|record=y}}.{{cite news |url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=Rt1VAAAAIBAJ&sjid=WeEDAAAAIBAJ&pg=6235%2C6684688 |work=Eugene
